title: [Backport 29.x] Harden Contact Sync delta URL and ownership checks (#9966)
summary: Contact Sync now validates delta URLs against an approved Microsoft Graph prefix and enforces record ownership to prevent malicious URL manipulation and cross-user record tampering.
key_points: Delta URLs are validated to match https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/ prefix before storage; invalid URLs trigger full sync fallback
Record ownership checks prevent users from inserting or modifying other users' sync records
User ID field changes on existing Contact Sync User records are now blocked
New subscriber codeunit wires validation logic into table insert and modify events
Install and upgrade contexts are exempt from ownership enforcement to prevent company copy regressions
